# University of Tennessee at Chattanooga

> UTC is a comprehensive public university offering experiential learning across engineering, business, arts, health, and nursing programs with strong student support and campus life.

The University of Tennessee at Chattanooga (UTC) serves students through multiple colleges including Arts and Sciences, Engineering and Computer Science, Business, Health, Education and Professional Studies, and Nursing. The university emphasizes enrollment management, student affairs, and comprehensive support services for traditional, transfer, graduate, international, military, and veteran students.

## Key Topics

- Experiential Learning
- College of Engineering and Computer Science
- College of Arts and Sciences
- Gary W. Rollins College of Business
- College of Health, Education and Professional Studies
- College of Nursing
- Admissions
- Financial Aid
- Student Services
- Campus Life
- Athletics
- Military and Veteran Support
- Crisis Support and Counseling
- Registration and Class Schedule
- International Students

## Admissions and Application

- [Admissions and Aid](https://www.utc.edu/about/admissions): UTC admissions for first-time, transfer, graduate, and international students with financial aid information
- [UTC Application Portal](https://www.utc.edu/apply): Online application portal for undergraduate, graduate, and international applicants
- [Parents](https://www.utc.edu/enrollment-management-and-student-affairs/admissions/parents): Parent resources for college admissions and student life support

## Academics and Programs

- [Academics and Majors](https://www.utc.edu/about/academics-and-majors): UTC majors across colleges of Arts and Sciences, Engineering and Computer Science, Business, Health, Education and Professional Studies, and Nursing
- [Class Schedule Information](https://www.utc.edu/academic-affairs/registrar/registration-information/class-schedule): Class schedule search and course registration information for enrolled students
- [UTC Library](https://www.utc.edu/library): Research databases, interlibrary loan, and comprehensive library services for academic support

## Student Life and Campus

- [Campus Life](https://www.utc.edu/about/campus-life): Student activities, housing, athletics, and campus organizations
- [Events Calendar](https://calendar.utc.edu): UTC events calendar featuring athletics, academics, and student activities
- [Student Resources](https://www.utc.edu/about/student-resources): MyMocs, MocSync, MocsNet tools and student services access portals

## Student Support Services

- [UTC Cares](https://www.utc.edu/enrollment-management-and-student-affairs/care): 24/7 crisis response, mental health, and counseling resources for student wellbeing
- [Veteran and Military Affairs](https://www.utc.edu/enrollment-management-and-student-affairs/veteran-and-military-affairs): Veteran and military student support services and resources
- [Faculty and Staff Resources](https://www.utc.edu/about/faculty-and-staff-resources): Faculty and staff services, HR, benefits, and professional development opportunities

## About UTC

- [Choose UTC](https://www.utc.edu): UTC homepage showcasing experiential learning and degree programs
- [About UTC](https://www.utc.edu/about): UTC mission, vision, values, history, and Chancellor information
- [Newsroom](https://www.utc.edu/newsroom): UTC news, press releases, and institutional updates
